6. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No. 2,3,5,6 alongwith other  accused with a common intention to cheat CW1 have  created documents claiming to be the owners of the  property, impersonated the CW1 and taken loans  against the property without the consent of the CW1and  thereby accused have committed the offences punishable  U/s.419, 420,465, 468, 471, 109, 120(B) r/w/s 34 IPC.?

My finding to the above points are as under:-

Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  8.
The witnesses cited in the charge sheet did not appeared and lead their evidence and there are no materials against accused No. 2,3,5,6 as Cws. 1 to 15
were not secured by the prosecution and they are dropped.

This court issued summons,
warrant and proclamation to Cws.1 to 15.
But the concerned police could not secure the presence of the witnesses in-spite of issuance of several times process by this court.
Moreover this case is of the year 2014.
The Cws.1 to 15 may not be secured in near future days.
Hence, prayer of Sr.APP to reissue witness summons to Cw's was rejected and CW-1 to 15 are dropped and prosecution side evidence is taken as Nil.

sentences.text:
In the absence of evidence of Cws.1 to 15, there are no material to show that the accused No. No. 2,3,5,6 have committed the offence punishable u/s. 419, 420,465, 468, 471, 109, 120(B)
r/w/s 34 IPC.
Hence, I hold that the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the guilt of the accused persons beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

9. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following;
 ORDER Acting Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused No.2,3,5 and 6 are hereby acquitted for the offences punishable U/s.419, 420,465, 468, 471, 109, 120(B) r/w/s 34 IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond of accused 2,3,5 and 6 shall stands cancelled.
As case against Accused No.1,4,7 to 9 is splitup, Office is hereby directed to preserve the records and property if any for future reference.
